tools.name: get_import_guide
tools.description: Returns how to describe boats for Boatopoly: the fields of one boat with their units, the boat types with their current categories, the allowed values and an example. Call it once before handing boats over.

tools.name: submit_boats
tools.description: Hands up to 100 boats over to Boatopoly, each an object in the format of get_import_guide. Returns a link for the seller: signed in to Boatopoly, the seller checks every boat in a preview and creates drafts from them. Nothing is published and no account is touched by this call. tools.description: Searches the boats for sale on Boatopoly (active adverts) with the filters of the website's search: words (manufacturer, model, words of the title or description, or an advert number), the boat type, the manufacturer, the model, new or used, the country, the price in euros, the length in metres and

tools.name: get_boat
tools.description: Returns the details of one boat for sale on Boatopoly: price, dimensions, year, engines, equipment notes, the description (in the language of the conversation when the seller has one), photos and the link to the advert. findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "ai-import-mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_boat · Private data: get_boat · Public sink: submit_boats · Destructive: submit_boats.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_boat · Private data: get_boat · Public sink: submit_boats · Destructive: submit_boats

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
